name: io.github.IvanBBaev/jira-mcp-ai
title: Jira Cloud
description: Jira Cloud over MCP: JQL search, issue reads, and writes behind a plan/apply gate.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Jira Cloud site: "mycompany", "mycompany.atlassian.net", or a full URL.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Atlassian account email used for Basic auth alongside the API token.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Atlassian API token for that account. Never logged; registered with the redactor.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Explicit path to the env file; wins over XDG and project-local resolution.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_TOKEN_EXPIRES
environmentVariables.description: ISO date the API token expires. Startup and doctor warn 30 days out.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of extra allowed hosts. Exact host or anchored regex; no suffix matching.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_ACTIVE_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Named credential profile used when a tool call does not specify one.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_LOCK_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Reject per-call profile switching. Locked by default so one call cannot change tenant.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_TOOL_PACKAGES
environmentVariables.description: Tool packages to register: a profile (core, reader, all) or an explicit comma list.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PACKAGES_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Packages to drop. Wins over the selection; the core package is force-re-added.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PACKAGES_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Packages whose write-tier tools are dropped before registration.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: plan: write tools describe the change. apply: they execute when the call passes apply.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_ALLOW_IRREVERSIBLE
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in for the irreversible tier (the deletes and the bulk delete/edit pair). Those tools refuse without it, even under apply.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_CALL_BUDGET_MS
environmentVariables.description: Wall-clock budget for one tool call's HTTP activity, retry waits and queueing included.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_HOST_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Per-host semaphore slots.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum retry attempts. Unsafe writes are never replayed on an ambiguous failure.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_MAX_RESULT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Truncation budget for a single tool result, in characters.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_MAX_PAGES
environmentVariables.description: Loop guard on paged reads.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_MEDIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory attachment downloads land in and uploads are read from. Unset: those tools refuse.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport to serve. stdio is the registered form; http is loopback-only.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Loopback port for the http transport.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the http transport. Required for it; unused under stdio.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Diagnostic verbosity. All log output goes to stderr; stdout is the MCP protocol.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_JOURNAL_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional JSONL journal of every write tool call: tool, args hash, result, timestamp.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Where credentials come from: basic (email + API token), oauth (OAuth 2.0 3LO, via jira-mcp-ai login) or pat (a Jira Data Center personal access token; only with JIRA_DEPLOYMENT=datacenter).

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_DEPLOYMENT
environmentVariables.description: cloud or datacenter. datacenter selects a read-only Data Center preview that has never been verified against a Data Center instance; it starts only with JIRA_DATACENTER_PREVIEW=true.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Jira Data Center personal access token, sent as a bearer. Required when JIRA_AUTH_MODE=pat.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_DATACENTER_PREVIEW
environmentVariables.description: Acknowledges that the Data Center adapter is an unverified read-only preview. Without it JIRA_DEPLOYMENT=datacenter does not start.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of the OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app. Required in oauth mode, ignored in basic mode.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app. Required in oauth mode: Atlassian authenticates the client on every token call, PKCE notwithstanding.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of scopes login asks consent for. Changing it after a successful login forces a re-consent.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_CLOUD_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pins the flow to one Jira Cloud site. Unset means the site is resolved from the accessible-resources endpoint on every run.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where login writes the token store, mode 0600. Defaults to oauth.json beside the env file.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_REDIRECT_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Loopback port login binds for the redirect callback. Must match the callback URL registered on the app character for character.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_AUTH_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the authorization server. Exists so the offline test harness can point the flow at a local fake.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_OAUTH_GATEWAY_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the OAuth API gateway oauth-mode requests are routed through instead of the site host.
